headline: Ribeiro's Plea
caption:
UFC fighter Brendson Ribeiro used his UFC Vegas 122 win to ask for help finding his missing brother.
Ribeiro says his brother disappeared on April 27 in his hometown in northern Brazil, and the family has had no answers in nearly six months. He asked the governor, the mayor and local authorities to help them learn what happened. The family fears the worst and says it just wants closure.

We hope Ribeiro's family gets the answers they deserve. 🙏

serious.title: Brendson Ribeiro asks for help finding his brother
facts: His brother went missing on April 27 in his hometown in northern Brazil
Ribeiro says authorities have given the family no answers
He made the plea after his UFC Vegas 122 win, asking the governor and mayor for help
serious.closing: We hope the family gets the answers they deserve.
